body.name: robust heavy-light interval handle
body.construction:
Use the partition \(\mathcal I\), with \(I_0\) splitting categories at pilot
arm-cell occupancy \(256\log(en)\).  From \(N_{ak}^{(s)}\) and
\(S_{ak}^{(s)}\), compute the light-cell point contribution
\(\widehat T_{\mathrm L}\) and its directly calibrated radius
\(\widehat R_{\mathrm L}\) using the four-coordinate factorial lift.  Compute
the heavy-cell preliminary point, variance, and aggregate self-normalized
radius using arm probabilities clipped to
\([\epsilon/2,1-\epsilon/2]\) and within-cell fourth-moment winsorization, as in
the heavy--light recipe.  Let
\[
 \mathcal H_n=
 \left\{\min_{a\in\{0,1\},\,1\le k\le d}N_{ak}^{(0)}
             >256\log(en)\right\}.
\]
On \(\mathcal H_n\), set the light point contribution and its contribution
to the total radius equal to zero and impose the exact assignments
\[
 \widehat\tau^{\mathrm{HL}}=\widehat\tau^{\mathrm{OS}},\qquad
 \widehat V^{\mathrm{HL}}=\widehat V^{\mathrm{OS}}.
\]
On \(\mathcal H_n^c\), retain the preliminary heavy--light point and variance
outputs.  In either branch, combine the applicable light-bias allowance and
the observable light and heavy score radii into
\(\widehat R^{\mathrm{HL}}\), and return
\[
 \widehat C^{\mathrm{HL}}
 = [\widehat\tau^{\mathrm{HL}}-\widehat R^{\mathrm{HL}},
    \widehat\tau^{\mathrm{HL}}+\widehat R^{\mathrm{HL}}]
   \cap[-2M,2M].
\]
